summary: CLI deploy tool ships a shared SSH key downloaded from a public GitHub repo
details: The `rx setup` and `rx deploy` subcommands download an SSH private key from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Renderfox743/sshkey/main/ssh-key-2026-07-19.key and use it to SSH/SCP the caller's built application to a hardcoded server at 79.72.65.161 as user `ubuntu`. The key is publicly hosted and identical for every user of the CLI, so it authorizes access to the author-operated deployment server rather than any installer-owned resource. There are no lifecycle hooks; the behavior fires only when the user explicitly invokes the CLI subcommands. The package does not read installer credentials, environment variables, or files outside the user's own project, and does not exfiltrate data to third-party destinations.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
